candidates.name: Simple Hepatic Cyst
support_spans: Abdominal ultrasonography revealed an 11 × 7.5 × 11.2 cm predominantly anechoic, thick-walled lesion arising from the inferior surface of the liver
candidates.why: The patient's presentation and imaging findings are consistent with a simple hepatic cyst, which is a benign lesion that can become infected.

candidates.name: Infected Hepatic Cyst
support_spans: Aspiration of the lesion yielded turbid fluid, but the lesion persisted despite repeated aspirations and antibiotic therapy
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory findings suggest an infected hepatic cyst, which is a complication of a simple hepatic cyst.

candidates.name: Hepatic Abscess
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with fever and turbid fluid on aspiration is consistent with a hepatic abscess, which is a localized collection of pus in the liver.

key_evidence_spans: Abdominal ultrasonography revealed an 11 × 7.5 × 11.2 cm predominantly anechoic, thick-walled lesion arising from the inferior surface of the liver

candidates.name: Infected non-parasitic cyst
support_spans: Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen demonstrated a well-defined, lobulated cystic lesion with a solid component in its superior part, abutting the colon and duodenum. The lesion was interpreted as an infected non-parasitic cyst.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging studies are consistent with an infected non-parasitic cyst.

candidates.name: Pyogenic liver abscess
support_spans: Aspiration of the lesion yielded turbid fluid, but the lesion persisted despite repeated aspirations and antibiotic therapy.
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with fever, abdominal discomfort, and a liver lesion that yielded turbid fluid on aspiration is consistent with a pyogenic liver abscess.

candidates.why: The patient's imaging studies are consistent with a simple liver cyst that has become infected.

rejected.label: Hepatic Abscess
rejected.why: While low-grade fever and turbid fluid support this, the specific description of the lesion as a cystic structure with a solid component on CT and its interpretation as an infected non-parasitic cyst makes it less likely.

rejected.label: Pyogenic liver abscess

rejected.label: Simple liver cyst infection
rejected.why: The detailed imaging and clinical findings better support a specific diagnosis of an infected non-parasitic cyst rather than a simple liver cyst infection.
